video_title: Lou - "Chet Checked Out!" + Should OKC Trade Chet Holmgren?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's performance in the series against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: He proved why he is one of the best players in the MVP and why he is the MVP.
quotes.quote: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was brilliant in this game. He proved why he is one of the best players in the MVP and why he is the MVP. Would I have liked to see him take that shot with the season on the line? Sure, but again, it didn't come down to that one play.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder's health issues impacted their performance against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: They are missing their second best player in Jalen Williams and also AJ Mitchell missing this part of the series.
quotes.quote: I don't think it showed that the Thunder have a Wembanyama problem. I think the Thunder had a health problem. They are missing their second best player in Jalen Williams and also AJ Mitchell missing this part of the series. It didn't really help them in this series.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren's lack of aggression and impact in the series
quotes.excerpt: It is not even about stats to me, it is just about making an impact on the game.
quotes.quote: It is not even about stats to me, it is just about making an impact on the game in a positive way and just being active and being there. Both teams made their fair share of mistakes, but everybody at some point found some aggression in this series. At some point, somebody found something aggressive to do, whether it was on the defensive end or on the offensive end. Bismack Biyombo came in and found an aggressive play. Jakob Poeltl came in and found an aggressive play. At some point, Chet Holmgren just had to give them something that they can use in a positive fashion.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Mental block for Chet Holmgren when facing Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I do think there is some sort of mental block when it comes to Victor Wembanyama.
quotes.quote: I do think there is some sort of mental block when it comes to Victor Wembanyama. I really do. I don't think it is like Space Jam, but I don't think he can take two shots in Game 7. You don't play 33 minutes and take two shots. I would rather live and die with going down with AJ Mitchell out and Jalen Williams out. I would rather have him be 0 for 15 than one for two.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Chet Holmgren needs to prioritize physical development this offseason
quotes.excerpt: Priority number one is his body. Go get 10 pounds of muscle on you.
quotes.quote: I think he does need to use this offseason to go work on certain things. Priority number one is his body. Go get 10 pounds of muscle on you. I think that helps you. You look at the frame of a Wembanyama. Chet Holmgren is not far off from that. You go add 10 pounds of muscle to your frame, I think you get a better defensive presence from Chet Holmgren. You don't see him getting bodied by Sheldon and getting pushed around by Vassell and things like that.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder should not panic or trade Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: You don't panic if you are the Oklahoma City Thunder. They are in the best position possible.
quotes.quote: You don't panic if you are the Oklahoma City Thunder. They are in the best position possible. We are talking about dynasties. These two could alternate the next four, five, six years. They are that good and they are going to dominate the Western Conference, no matter what they do. Even if they don't change anything right now, I swear I will probably still pick the Thunder to win it all next year.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading Chet Holmgren is not a viable option for Thunder
quotes.excerpt: To give up on a young talent like that that early, I think that is a bit of a reach.
quotes.quote: If it is something that is just a clear-cut better option, then obviously you are in the position to at least consider it. But once again, I have to put emphasis on this is a 23-year-old kid. He still has a lot of basketball left, he still has a lot of improvement to make. So to give up on a young talent like that that early, I think that is a bit of a reach. As far as Lou Dort, I do see him being on the move. You got to think of the young prospect behind him in Cason Wallace who is obviously proving himself in this series.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder have assets to improve without trading Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: I am with the guys. You don't give up on Chet Holmgren.
quotes.quote: I am with the guys. You don't give up on Chet Holmgren, but obviously Oklahoma City has a ton of assets. They can make a lot of different moves to strengthen this group, but you got a lot of that right there you are building already. Jalen Williams is going to come back, he is going to be better than ever. He is going to use this experience and his injury to light a fire up on him. Cason Wallace is another guy that proved his worth. I think they make a couple of adjustments. I think Lou Dort is going to be the adjustment.
